# Arda's Advanced Items

**Arda's Advanced Items** aims to enhance your late-game Minecraft experience by introducing a tier of equipment that goes beyond ordinary limits. This mod provides players with harder, stronger, and more durable gear to make survival not just possible, but efficient.

![,,](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95f4acb7f1c673c52307d1b73f30f72e32a843bf.png)

## Advanced Tiers

### Advanced Diamond
A significant upgrade from your everyday gems.
* **2X Durability:** All Advanced Diamond tools and weapons have exactly double the durability of standard diamond items.
* **Stronger Protection:** A full set of Advanced Diamond armor provides a much harder defensive layer.

### Advanced Netherite
The pinnacle of survival technology. 
* **Ultimate Power:** Every piece is designed to be more powerful than standard Netherite.
* **Smithing System:** Requires the **Advanced Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template** to craft, adding a true sense of progression.

![,,](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95f4acb7f1c673c52307d1b73f30f72e32a843bf.png)

## Advanced Baubles (Curios System)
Equip these unique items in the special **Arda's Advanced Items Slot** to gain permanent, game-changing buffs:

| Item | Effect | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Diamond Feather** | Speed | "Fast as a cat!" |
| **Netherite Feather** | Speed & Durability | "Fast and durable!" |
| **Diamond Amethyst Shard** | Luck | "I am very lucky!" |
| **Netherite Amethyst Shard** | Luck & Strength | "Lucky and strong!" |
| **Ghast Tear Diamond** | Slow Falling | "Falling slowly!" |
| **Advanced Netherite Diamond** | Fire Immunity | "The fire doesn't hurt anymore!" |

![,,](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95f4acb7f1c673c52307d1b73f30f72e32a843bf.png)

## Resources & Blocks
* **Advanced Diamond Block:** A high-tier storage and decorative block.
* **Advanced Netherite Ingot Block:** The heaviest and most reinforced block in the game.
* **Upgrade Template:** Find or craft the **Advanced Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template** to start your transformation.

![,,](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95f4acb7f1c673c52307d1b73f30f72e32a843bf.png)

## Technical Details
* **Generator:** NeoForge 1.21.1
* **Dependencies:** Requires **[Curios API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/curios)** to use the accessory slots.
* **Compatibility:** Features **JEI (Just Enough Items)** support to see all crafting recipes easily.
